nodes.name: 5.1.1 Trigger - Call Notes / Transcript In
nodes.notes: STAR TOPOLOGY (S5.4): this Execute Workflow Trigger input is now what the Hub-Dispatcher calls off a `reply.received` event in funnel_events, instead of whichever ad-hoc source called it before (manually pasted call notes today, since no dialer/transcript source is wired yet - see 4.2.x blocker). Field shape (client_id, opportunity_id, call_notes_text, source) is unchanged - the Dispatcher's Switch branch for `reply.received` maps the event's payload JSONB onto these same four fields, so no node logic below had to change, only who calls this trigger. opportunity_id maps to Stage 27's 'Opportunity ID' field.

nodes.name: Ollama Extraction - BANT
nodes.notes: 5.1.1.2. Field set (budget/authority/need/timeline) is the standard BANT acronym, not an invented weighting/threshold - no scoring or decision logic here, extraction only, per rule against inventing BANT weights.

nodes.name: Ollama Extraction - MEDDIC
nodes.notes: 5.1.1.3. metrics/economic_buyer/decision_criteria/decision_process/identify_pain/champion/competition are the standard MEDDIC(C) field names - extraction only, no invented scoring.

nodes.name: Insert qualification_records
nodes.notes: REQUIRES SCHEMA CONFIRMATION if qualification_records (§16.5) hasn't been created yet - same table as flagged in 4.3.3's README, one CREATE TABLE covers both.

value.payload: ={{ JSON.stringify({ opportunity_id: $json.opportunity_id, qualification_record_id: $('Insert qualification_records').item.json.id, framework_used: $json.framework_used, decision: $json.decision, extraction_had_parse_error: $json.extraction_had_parse_error }) }}

nodes.name: Report to Hub - qualification.scored
nodes.notes: STAR TOPOLOGY (S5.4): replaces the old direct 'Hand off to 5.1.2' Execute Workflow mesh-link. This spoke no longer knows 5.1.2's workflow ID at all - it only reports `qualification.scored` to Hub-Intake with client_id + payload (opportunity_id, the qualification_records.id just inserted, framework_used, decision, extraction_had_parse_error). The Hub-Dispatcher's Switch node is what routes `qualification.scored` on to 5.1.2 (S5.5) - that wiring lives once on the Dispatcher, not here. REQUIRES: workflowId.value must be filled in with the real Hub-Intake workflow ID once S1 (Build Hub-Intake) is done - same single-place-to-fill pattern the plan uses everywhere else, not a per-spoke placeholder.

starTopologyChanges: Trigger is now Dispatcher-called off a `reply.received` funnel_events row instead of an ad-hoc caller - field shape unchanged, only the caller changed.
Removed the direct 'Hand off to 5.1.2' Execute Workflow node (mesh link) - this spoke no longer references 5.1.2's workflow ID.
Added 'Report to Hub - qualification.scored' node calling Hub-Intake with {event_type, client_id, payload}; Hub-Dispatcher now owns routing on to 5.1.2 (S5.5).
